title: Jubilant Light Turkish Fennel Wrap
description: A nutty and light Turkish dish featuring fennel, perfect for a monsoon day, wrapped in a pandan leaf wrap, making it a great shojin-friendly option. This wrap is filled with the flavors of Turkey and the freshness of fennel.
instructions: Start by preparing the pandan leaves for wrapping by cleaning and drying them.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced fennel, chickpeas, red onion, and chopped walnuts.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sumac, lemon juice, and olive oil to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the fennel mixture and toss to combine.
Spoon about 1/2 cup of the fennel mixture onto the center of a pandan leaf.
Fold the bottom half of the leaf up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Serve the wraps immediately and enjoy.
You can store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a day.
